scares.description: Diana and Rosa are startled as they shine their torches on each other.
Veronica suddenly sits up and lets out an unnatural scream.
As Veronica reaches out to touche the glass cup, the television suddenly turns on.
Hands reach out and pull Veronica onto the bed.
Accompanied by a sound effect, the demon walks into Lucia’s room.
Veronica sees a figure in the window.
Veronica touches the mattress and a hand reaches out of it and grabs her.
Antoñito, who is standing by the kitchen door, is pulled away by the demon.
The demon walks past the window.
There is a bolt of lightning and the demon can briefly be seen in the corner of the room.
